audience: construction safety and site teams that review inspections, issues and incidents in HammerTech

useCases.title: List projects and their locations
useCases.text: List the projects with their state, country and dates. List the locations of one project to see its area names.

useCases.title: Review issues and their due dates
useCases.text: List the issues to read the priority, status and due date of each one. Select the fields you need, and read the next page while more results exist.

useCases.title: Count inspections and their open issues
useCases.text: List the inspections with their completion date and count of open issues. Count the completed inspections for one month.

useCases.title: Review incident reports and permits
useCases.text: List the incident reports with their date, type, near-miss flag and status. List the permits with their type, status and times.
